title: Ox Passion Citrus Mango Guava Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Citrus Mango Guava delivers a bold trio of tropical and citrus fruits, blending sweet Mango, juicy Guava, and zesty Citrus into one vibrant vape. The Mango provides a rich, velvety base, lifted by the tart edge of Guava and finished with a bright citrus kick that keeps the flavour feeling clean and energising. Formulated with nicotine salts for fast nicotine delivery and a smooth throat hit, this e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio and designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits. It works best with pod systems, starter pens, and compact refillable devices. Available in both 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, OX Passion Nic Salts offer bold, layered flavour profiles with a consistently smooth finish. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping hardware, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to pair seamlessly with Oxva XLIM pod kits and other refillable MTL vape devices.
